matrix_layout.matrix_semantics: animal rows x plant columns; transpose to plant rows x pollinator columns

selection_rule: Roles are determined only from exact workbook sheet labels and the source description in the first cell. No Doré reconciliation or Tier-B metric value is used to select a sheet.
cross_system_unit_rule: Restored and control networks are two nested observations within one Mauritius system and must be withheld together in any cross-system LOSO.
claim_boundary: Primary visitation-rate weights are visits/flower/hour. Secondary interaction-strength weights multiply visitation rate by floral abundance. Neither is single-visit effectiveness or reproductive success.
